page: Amazon Web Services r7gd.16xlarge is a memory-optimized server powered by 64 dedicated physical AWS Graviton Neoverse-V1 cores using the ARM64 architecture. Operating at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz, this instance features 512.0 GB of system memory, providing 8.0 GB of RAM per core. It includes 3800 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 30 Gbps, running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieved a top-tier score of 20,690.0 on Geekbench multi-core and 58,508.0 for software compilation. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 6,200.09 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 253.52 GB/sec for large-block uncached reads. Database and caching operations are also robust, with Redis SET operations reaching 101.36 million operations per second and Passmark database operations scoring 31,336.22.

While multi-threaded performance and memory throughput are strong, single-core metrics are average, with a stress-ng single-core score of 1,532.98. Additionally, LLM text generation on small models is poor at 9.82 tokens per second, though medium model text generation is stronger at 30.27 tokens per second. Given the high memory capacity, dedicated ARM64 cores, and fast local NVMe storage, this instance is well-suited for memory-intensive databases, caching layers, software compilation, and high-throughput web serving.
